title: RelationEvidence
description: A record that one NON-EMPTY set of evidence units JOINTLY supports or refutes one DerivedRelation. Conjunctive vs. alternative: several anchors within ONE record mean U1 AND U2 AND ... are jointly required; alternative / independently sufficient bases MUST be represented as SEPARATE RelationEvidence records (E1 OR E2). Evidence identity: EvidenceKey(e) = ⟨relationId, anchors, stance⟩, where each anchor already carries its optional selector, so selectors participate in identity through the anchor set. Re-executing a pipeline over the same relation, anchors, and stance MUST NOT create false independent evidence; it SHOULD append a new ProvenanceActivity instead. STANCE (`supports`/`refutes`) describes ONLY the relationship between the cited evidence basis and the normalized proposition; it MUST NOT substitute for proposition polarity, extractor disagreement, normative conflict, exceptions/scope, or review disagreement.

id.description: Opaque, unique identifier for this evidence record.

relationId.description: Identifier of the DerivedRelation this evidence bears on. Exactly one relation per record.

anchors.description: The evidence units that JOINTLY form this basis (conjunctive). MUST contain at least one anchor.

stance.description: Whether this basis supports or refutes the proposition. Not a substitute for polarity or disagreement.

reviewStatus.description: Curation lifecycle status of this evidence record.

provenanceActivityIds.description: Identifiers of ProvenanceActivity records that produced or reprocessed this evidence occurrence.

reviewEventIds.description: Identifiers of ReviewEvent records affecting this evidence record.
